assertions.quoted_span: "disposition": "implements_clock", "ref": null, "why": "\"indagini annuali\" implements B-CLK-EU-10/15(2); the C/p pairs restate EU 10/15; the pre-M5 5 km band coincides with EU 15(2)(a) v1 (B-PAR-EU-15(2)(a)-v1)"
assertions.claim: The expression-level remediation does not fit the five-field disposition shape: 40 of 63 implements_clock rows and 29 of 64 restates_parameter rows have null ref, while their prose grounds name one or several clocks or parameters, so a consumer must parse why to recover the claimed targets and Stage B fails one meaning per field and computability.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Human-reread the affected expressions and emit one disposition per independently claimed mint with a non-null ref, or ratify a typed refs union where one indivisible expression genuinely implements multiple mints; then require references for implements_clock and restates_parameter.
assertions.falsifier: Every null-ref implements_clock and restates_parameter row is formally declared to carry no machine-consumable target, and no Stage C, audit, or closure consumer needs to identify the clock or parameter that the disposition says it implements or restates.

assertions.quoted_span: if sorted(mc) != sorted(c['clock_id'] for c in b['clocks']): fail('closure manifest clock_ids do not partition the canonical clocks')
assertions.claim: The new partition check proves only global multiset coverage, not the seam membership that closure_manifest now solely owns: swapping a clock ID between seams 1 and 2 still passes, even though each row's producer remains assigned to a different seam in population.json.
assertions.proposed_remedy: For each manifest seam, require every listed clock and parameter producer_provision_version_id to belong to that same population.json seam, in addition to retaining the global exact-partition check.
assertions.falsifier: An executed check elsewhere derives each listed row's producer seam from population.json and rejects any manifest entry whose seam differs.

assertions.claim: The newly authored expression ground contradicts both its own expression and the producer source_quote by identifying Annex I where the legal text says Allegato III, so the derived disposition log records a false ground despite reaching the defensible not_a_parameter class.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Correct the authored ground to Annex III after a human reread of the complete Article 9(1) source_quote.

assertions.quoted_span: "note": "Distance from the island to the nearest Union land territory; strictly greater than 5 km disapplies the 15(2)(a) band."
assertions.claim: The replacement note convention is a dead letter: the verifier neither requires nor reads conventions.note and accepts arbitrary non-empty rationale, while this live note repeats the structured value, comparator, scope purpose and consumer_decision instead of carrying a source-stated interaction or genuine open term.
assertions.proposed_remedy: Set this redundant note to null, mechanically require the note convention to be present, and retain human reread—not length or keyword code—as the gate for whether each non-null note satisfies that convention.
assertions.falsifier: The quoted note carries a source-stated interaction or genuine open term that is not already represented by value, comparator, scope, or consumer_decision.
